title: Checks for calls to .drain() that clear the collection, immediately followed by a call to .collect().
summary: Using mem::take is faster as it avoids the allocation. When using mem::take, the old collection is replaced with an empty one and ownership of the old collection is returned. Clippy puts this lint in the perf group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for calls to std::mem::drop with a value that does not implement Drop.
summary: Calling std::mem::drop is no different than dropping such a type. A different value may have been intended. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.
